name: Export a message as EML
description: Export a mailbox message as an EML file in playbook shared storage, with its exact downloaded-byte SHA-256.

user.title: User
user.description: Mailbox user ID or user principal name (UPN).

message_id.title: Graph Message ID
message_id.description: Full Microsoft Graph item ID of the target message in the mailbox specified by User. Use message_id returned by Search messages or List messages in a folder for this mailbox. Copy the complete value (often starting with AAMk or AAk); do not use email.message_id or an Internet Message-ID such as <...@...>. A message object containing message_id is also accepted.

max_size_mb.title: Maximum size (MiB)
max_size_mb.description: Maximum downloaded EML size. Oversized or incomplete files are removed.

content_type.description: MIME type of the exported file: message/rfc822.

error_details.description: Safe structured errors. retryable refers to retrying the whole action; it is false after a modifying request.

file_name.description: Generated filename, independent of untrusted message subjects.

file_path.description: Relative file path in this playbook shared storage. Pass it to Upload attachment in the same playbook run.

outcome.description: Overall action outcome. Partial, failed and unknown outcomes also flag an SDK action error; inspect retained results before retrying.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact MIME bytes downloaded from Microsoft Graph.
